journey: chart cell -> More actions menu -> close -> reopen
frozen_by: analytics-2 rebuild lane, before any menu or chart fix
property_not_literal: This case freezes BEHAVIOUR, not today's item list. It must keep passing when the menu's contents are corrected: the check compares the menu's own two observations (before close, after reopen), so adding, removing or renaming items is allowed as long as the set is stable across a close and a re-open.

identity.cell: a cell whose kind is Chart

checks.expect: the cell output contains a chart surface
checks.why: the app's own cell vocabulary defines this kind as a Chart; a Chart that renders only a table contradicts its own contract

checks.expect: menu open, focus on the first item
menu end edge within 4px of the trigger end edge
menu closed after the trigger is clicked again
checks.requires: trusted input; NOT_ESTABLISHED when the collector has none

checks.expect: focus back on the trigger after close
checks.requires: trusted input; NOT_ESTABLISHED when the collector has none

checks.expect: identical item list, same order, on the second open

controls: e2e/postclick/selftest.mjs runs one clean observation and five mutants offline: a chart that renders only a table, a menu that never closes, a re-open that drops an item, a re-open that reorders items, and focus lost on close. Each mutant must FAIL exactly the check it breaks; a check that cannot fail is not a check.
not_claimed: any comparison against another product's rendered screen (no reference capture exists for this journey)
escape-key or outside-click dismissal (no trusted-input driver on a background tab)
that today's menu items are correct: the item list is a candidate finding, and the stability check is written to survive its repair
